en.title: n×n Square of Asterisks
en.description:
Given a positive integer n, output n identical lines; each line contains n asterisks, with exactly one space between adjacent asterisks.

Standard input/output and this site's supplementary ranges follow this problem's description.
en.input: One line containing an integer n, 1≤n≤100.
en.output: Output exactly n lines; each line contains n asterisks, with one space between adjacent asterisks.
en.explanation: Build one line of n asterisks joined by single spaces, then output that line n times.
hints: Build one line of n asterisks joined by single spaces, then output that line n times.
